content:
Maria: Heads-up — ACME pen-test window confirmed for 2026-04-07 to 2026-04-09. We need ephemeral KMS keys for evidence upload, RBAC changes in staging, and a clear audit-export path. Who can own RBAC delta and evidence upload window?
Jordan: I can own RBAC changes for staging only. Need a list of assessor principals + expiry (max 6h). Also want a rollback plan in case of regressions.
Maria: Assessor team asked for S3 presigned URLs + read access to the staging logs. Prefer temp role 'pt-assessor' with minimal permissions. We'll limit to 4h if possible.
Ben: Agreed. For KMS, use envelope encryption with a customer-managed key scoped to staging. Flow: Assessor -> assume-role (STS) -> presigned S3 PUT -> KMS Encrypt used server-side. Sample IAM policy for the role:
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action": ["s3:PutObject","s3:GetObject"],"Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-assessments/*"},
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/pt-staging-*"}
  ]
}
```
Carla: On logging — enable CloudTrail for data events on the target bucket and forward to the readonly log-archive. Set retention 365d. SIEM team wants an alert for >50 GetObject/min from a single role or IP.
sec-bot: :rotating_light: Reminder: Evidence bucket prefix `/assessments/ACME-PT/` reserved. Upload manifest.json with checksums. See https://redwood.internal/pt-guides/evidence.
Dino: For triage, we'll use the vuln tracker spreadsheet (https://docs.google.com/pt-spreadsheet). Add columns: severity, reproducer, PR, mitigation ETA, retest slot. I'll own the triage sheet during the window.
Maria: I'll prepare a runbook with exact timestamps and tag Jira tickets with `pt-evidence-ready`. Also we need a deploy freeze 2h before the assessor window.
Jordan: Plan to apply RBAC delta in staging on 2026-04-06 02:00 UTC. Will post the exact iam diff in this thread when ready.
Ben: I'll produce a presigned URL generator and a short key-rotation script. Quick snippet:
```
#!/bin/bash
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt-assessor --role-session-name pt-upload | jq -r .Credentials.SessionToken
# then generate presigned URL
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-pt-assessments/ACME-PT/evidence.tar.gz --expires-in 14400
```
Carla: Confirming SIEM rule and retention. Also request: enable object-level logging for the service-account used by deploys to distinguish assessor vs internal automation.
Maria: Thanks team. @pt-bot can you open intake ticket ACME-PT-2026 and assign to Maria, Jordan, Ben, Carla, Dino? Let's run a dry-run upload Wednesday (2026-04-01) to validate presigned flow and audit exports.
Jordan: LGTM, will follow up with the IAM diff.
Ben: Putting scripts in `eng-security/pt-scripts` and will ping here when pushed. :thumbsup: 
Maria: Perfect — marking this thread as the evidence-handshake thread. We'll update last_message_ts after dry-run.
